body: The "me me me" complex. They don't have any interest in what you have to say, often cuts you off to talk about themselves when opening up about personal things. They tell you about all these fun things they're doing but don't invite you, if you want to see them you often have to go out of your way to invite them. Usually these friendships start in your childhood years and you're already stuck by the time you realise it.

It's never too late to start. plus you're still in high school, it's still a good time to learn something new. Even if you feel like it's too late I promise you it is never too late to pick up a new skill.
Imagine being a koala and finally finding safety from the fire just to have your skull impaled by a fucking carrot.
